name: Anime Pilgrimage Road
tagline: Every region is planned around real anime scenes — Girls Band Cry, Bocchi, Yuru Camp, Love Live, Euphonium, Sabbat of the Witch — with Pegasis's driving must-dos placed between them.
summary: Three Tokyo nights cover Bocchi (SHELTER live show), Kaguya-sama, Akihabara/Nakano/Ikebukuro goods and the Girls Band Cry Kawasaki walk, ending with Pegasis driving to Daikoku. One rental car then runs Enoshima, the Hakone Turnpike, Evangelion's Lake Ashi, Otome Pass, Yuru Camp's Motosu and Love Live's Uchiura before it is dropped in Mishima. Kansai has the Nara fire festival, the Suzuka EV kart, Uji and all Sabbat of the Witch places in Kyoto, Kobe and Osaka. A midday flight from Itami leads to 3 ryokan nights at Niseko (Rusutsu drift course, ski) and 3 nights in Sapporo with a day trip to Asahiyama.

who.pegasis: IN: Daikoku (self-drive, Thu), Hakone Turnpike, Taikanzan, Otome Pass, Gotemba outlets, Suzuka EV kart, Rusutsu snow drift, Niseko, Nara fire festival, SHELTER live show, Nakano, Radio Kaikan, Ikebukuro goods route, Maidreamin, TMG free view, Omoide Yokocho/Golden Gai, Narita bus, Asahiyama penguins, Garaku, Daruma, Moiwa. OUT: Onuma (on the Hakodate side, not on this route); Isetan half-price food only as an evening option. He also joins Enoshima and Uji, which he marked 'not interested' (kept short), and sleeps in while Aoki does Fushimi Inari.
who.aoki: IN: Tokyo anime wants (Radio Kaikan, ZEST, Nakano, Shimokitazawa, SHELTER live, Ikebukuro, maid café, GBC Tokyo Station and Kawasaki spots, Omoide Yokocho, TMG), Enoshima/Slam Dunk, Yuru Camp Motosu, Evangelion Hakone, Lake Kawaguchi, Hanz villa, Daikoku, Nara, Fushimi Inari dawn, Kinkakuji, Den Den Town, Namba food, Suzuka, Rusutsu drift, Niseko with a beginner lesson, Daruma, Moiwa, Sabbat of the Witch, Numazu (short). OUT: Fuji Motorsports Museum, Nissan Crossing, Fujiten ski, Shibuya Sky, Liberty Walk, Toyota Commemorative Museum, Yokohama Chinatown, Cape Kamui (winter walkway), Suga Shrine (no time; 10 min from the hotel if you get up early on Jan 20). Kaguya-sama and Uji are in although Aoki marked them 'not interested': both are short.

cost.transport: ≈ ¥110,000 per person (Tokyo trains ¥5,000, Kawasaki→Mishima car share ¥22,000 incl. one-way fee and tolls, Hikari ¥11,500, Suzuka day ¥16,000, Kansai trains ¥6,000, JAL Itami→CTS ¥13,030, Hokkaido car share ¥25,000, Asahikawa trains ¥10,000)
cost.hotels: ≈ ¥175,000 per person (Super Hotel 3 n ¥25,700, Hanz half board ¥21,500, Kyoto 3 n ¥27,000, Osaka ¥9,000, Yukoro-tei 3 n with 2 meals ≈ ¥66,000, Route Inn Sapporo 3 n ≈ ¥25,500)
cost.activities: ≈ ¥95,000 Pegasis / ¥65,000 Aoki (SHELTER ¥3,600, maid cafés ¥7,000, Suzuka ¥3,500, Nara/Kinkakuji ¥1,300, drift ride-along ¥8,500 + Pegasis drive ¥31,000, ski lifts and rental ¥30,000, Aoki lessons ¥20,000, Moiwa/zoo ¥3,100) — goods shopping not included
cost.total: ≈ ¥380,000 Pegasis / ¥350,000 Aoki, plus food (≈ ¥4,000–5,000 a day outside the ryokan dinners), excl. international flights

flights: Pegasis: WestJet Toronto 09:35 Mon Jan 18 → Calgary → Narita 16:30 Tue Jan 19; home Air Canada New Chitose about 19:35 Tue Feb 2 → Vancouver → Toronto 19:57 same day (open-jaw about CA$1,247).

Aoki: Air China Shanghai Pudong 09:40 → Narita 13:40 Tue Jan 19 (about CA$376; Spring 15:00 → 18:40 is CA$304 but lands after Pegasis); home Spring Airlines New Chitose 13:50 → Shanghai Pudong 17:00 Tue Feb 2 (about ¥83,000 because of Chinese New Year: book early).
Osaka → Hokkaido: JAL Osaka Itami 11:45 → New Chitose 13:35, Wed Jan 27 (from ¥13,030, 20 kg bag included).

places.ja: 成田国際空港
places.blurb: Both of you land here on Jan 19. The Airport Bus TYO-NRT to Tokyo Station leaves from the bus stops outside arrivals.

info.label: IC card
info.value: Buy a Welcome Suica or use a phone Suica

tips: Late-night and early-morning buses cost ¥3,000.

places.ja: 東京駅 丸の内南口ドーム
places.blurb: Girls Band Cry episode 1: Nina steps out under this dome when she arrives in Tokyo. You arrive in Tokyo the same way.
tips: Look straight up: the dome ceiling has eagles and zodiac reliefs.
Buses from Narita stop at the Yaesu side: walk through the station (about 7 min).

places.ja: スーパーホテル新宿歌舞伎町
places.blurb: A clean business hotel 7 min from Shinjuku Station, with a free breakfast buffet. Nights 1–3 (Jan 19–21).
tips: Join the free Smart Membership and book on the official site: about ¥500 back per night.
On Jan 21 the car stays overnight: use a coin parking lot nearby (about ¥2,000–3,500 per night).

places.ja: 思い出横丁
places.blurb: A narrow alley of tiny yakitori bars beside the Shinjuku tracks. A good first dinner after the flight.
tips: Many bars have a seat charge (お通し) of ¥300–500.
Golden Gai (200 tiny bars) is 8 min east if you still have energy.

places.en: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building, free observatory
places.ja: 東京都庁 展望室
places.blurb: A free 202 m view deck 10 min from the hotel. On a clear winter morning you see Mt Fuji to the west.
tips: Wed Jan 20 both decks are open.
Security check at the 1F lift: small queue before 10:00.

places.ja: 三田通り・三田国際ビル
places.blurb: Kaguya-sama is set in Minato ward: the school walk is Mita-dori by Keio University, and the shared-umbrella scene (S1 ep 5) is at Mita Kokusai Building.

info.label: From station
info.value: Tamachi Station West Exit, 8 min walk

tips: Walk Tamachi → Keio University main gate (三田通り) → Mita Kokusai Building → back to Tamachi.
Keio campus is a working university: photos from the street only.

places.en: Ikebukuro anime goods route (Animate main store, Surugaya, K-BOOKS)
places.ja: アニメイト池袋本店・駿河屋・K-BOOKS
places.blurb: Chinese fans now call Ikebukuro the best place for anime goods: the 9-floor Animate main store, then Surugaya and Lashinbang for used goods and the row of K-BOOKS shops.
tips: Route: Animate → Stellaworth (2F, across the road) → Surugaya 1F + Lashinbang 3F → K-BOOKS buildings toward Sunshine City.
Eat lunch in the Sunshine 60-dori side streets.

places.ja: 中野ブロードウェイ
places.blurb: A 1960s shopping block full of Mandarake shops: used figures, manga, cels and retro toys on 4 floors.
tips: Go after 13:00: many small shops open late.
Mandarake shops are on 2F–4F; the 3F 'Special' shops have rare items.

places.ja: 下北沢（ぼっち・ざ・ろっく！聖地）
places.blurb: Bocchi the Rock's home area: the station, Honda Theater, Donguri Hiroba park (ep 4) and the Senrogai empty lot (ep 5), plus used-clothes and record shops.
tips: Walk the spots while there is daylight (sunset about 16:55).
Do not photograph private houses.

places.ja: 下北沢SHELTER
places.blurb: The real live house behind STARRY in Bocchi the Rock. You go inside for an evening show, like Kessoku Band's first live.
tips: The Jan 20, 2027 line-up appears about December 2026: buy the ticket then (pick up at 7-Eleven or FamilyMart).
Standing only. Enter by the number on your ticket.

places.ja: 秋葉原ラジオ会館
places.blurb: Ten floors of figure, card and model shops right at the Electric Town exit. Oshi no Ko's Akihabara ZEST live venue is a 3-min walk north.

info.label: Station
info.value: 秋葉原駅 電気街口

tips: Take the lift to the top and walk down.
Ignore the street maids who hand out flyers; go to a known café.

places.ja: めいどりーみん 秋葉原本店
places.blurb: Big maid café with a small stage: the maids sing and dance, and first-timers get a 'passport'. Lunch here.

info.label: Price
info.value: ¥880 per hour entry + food; ¥2,000–2,500 with lunch

info.label: Pay
info.value: Cash, cards, PayPay, WeChat Pay, Alipay

tips: Reserve on the official site to skip a queue.
Photo with a maid costs extra.

places.ja: ラゾーナ川崎プラザ ルーファ広場
places.blurb: Girls Band Cry: the open square where the band plays on the street. Start the GBC stamp tour here.
tips: Island Mura Guitars closed on Sep 23, 2026: check the new stamp list in January 2027.

places.ja: 多摩川見晴らし公園
places.blurb: Girls Band Cry: the riverside park by the Tama River where Nina and Momoka talk. Wide sky, trains crossing the bridge.

info.label: From station
info.value: Kawasaki West Exit, 1 km (15 min walk)

tips: Windy and cold by the river: bring gloves.

places.ja: 丸福珈琲店 川崎アゼリア店
places.blurb: Girls Band Cry café scene, under the East Exit plaza (another scene spot). Hotcakes and strong coffee to warm up.
tips: The East Exit plaza (川崎駅東口 駅前広場) stamp is right above you.

places.ja: クラブチッタ（ラ チッタデッラ）
places.blurb: Girls Band Cry's big live-house stage. The Italian-style La Cittadella streets are lit after dark; eat dinner here.
tips: Check the CLUB CITTA' schedule: if a show fits, it is a second live night.

places.en: Toyota Rent a Car Kawasaki-ekimae Nishiguchi (in MUZA Kawasaki)
places.ja: トヨタレンタカー 川崎駅前西口店（ミューザ川崎1F）
places.blurb: Pick up the car here for Daikoku, the Hakone–Fuji drive and the drop at Mishima. It is inside MUZA Kawasaki, the GBC concert hall (Tomo's piano).

info.label: Rent
info.value: Thu Jan 21 18:30 → Sat Jan 23 about 11:30, one way to Mishima

info.label: Tyres
info.value: Ask for studless tyres (スタッドレスタイヤ): needed for Fuji roads

tips: One-way (乗り捨て) fee Kawasaki → Mishima is about ¥11,000 (check when you book).
Pegasis: bring licence + IDP + passport. Aoki: licence accepted in Japan.

places.ja: 大黒PA
places.blurb: The famous JDM car meet under the looping expressway ramps. Pegasis drives in himself, no guide.

info.label: Access
info.value: By car only (Shuto Wangan / Kanagawa routes)

tips: If police close the PA, drive on to Tatsumi PA (辰巳第一PA, 20 min) and Umihotaru is not needed.
Be quiet and polite; no revving, no photos of plates without asking.

places.ja: 江島神社・片瀬江ノ島駅
places.blurb: Bocchi the Rock episode 9: the band's trip to Enoshima. Red torii, stone steps, tako-senbei at Asahi Honten, and the dragon-palace Katase-Enoshima station across the bridge.

info.label: Parking
info.value: Enoshima island prefectural car parks (about ¥1,000–1,500/half day)

tips: Clear winter mornings show Mt Fuji across Sagami Bay.
Pegasis marked this 'not interested': it is a 2-hour morning stop on his coast drive day.

places.ja: 鎌倉高校前駅 踏切
places.blurb: The Slam Dunk opening shot: a green Enoden train, a rail crossing and the sea. Two Enoden stops from Enoshima.
tips: Stay on the sidewalk and follow the guards. Do not stand in the road.

places.ja: 大観山（アネスト岩田ターンパイク箱根）
places.blurb: The Hakone Turnpike (14 km of smooth curves from Odawara) ends here at 1,011 m, with Mt Fuji over Lake Ashi.
tips: Ice is most common before 10:00: you drive it at about noon.
Eat lunch at the Sky Lounge at the top.

places.en: Lake Ashi north shore, Kojiri (Evangelion Tokyo-3)
places.ja: 芦ノ湖 湖尻（第3新東京市）
places.blurb: Evangelion's Tokyo-3 is Hakone: the city meets Lake Ashi here, and Sengokuhara just north is its centre. Drive through with the Eva opening song on.
tips: Eva goods and collabs change often; there was no fixed Eva shop confirmed for 2027.

places.ja: 乙女峠
places.blurb: The Route 138 pass between Sengokuhara and Gotemba, with a big Fuji view from the Fujimi-chaya side.
tips: Stop only in the marked lay-by, not on the road.

places.ja: 御殿場プレミアム・アウトレット
places.blurb: Large outlet mall with Mt Fuji behind the shops. Good for ski wear before Hokkaido.
tips: Tax-free counter: bring passports.
Buy warm gloves and a neck warmer for Niseko here.

places.ja: HANZ OUTDOOR RESORT 河口湖
places.blurb: Fuji-view villa (glamping style) in the forest south of Lake Kawaguchi, with its own indoor hot tub. Night 4 (Jan 22).

info.label: Price
info.value: About CA$275 with breakfast (Expedia, refundable); half board about +CA$126

tips: Book half board: there is little food nearby in the evening.
You leave at 06:30: ask for a breakfast box the night before.

places.en: Lake Kawaguchi north shore, Oishi Park
places.ja: 河口湖 大石公園
places.blurb: The classic Fuji-over-the-lake view from the north shore. At sunrise Fuji turns pink.
tips: Very cold at dawn (−5 °C or less): hat and gloves.

places.ja: 浩庵キャンプ場（本栖湖）
places.blurb: Yuru Camp episode 1: Rin's solo camp, where Nadeshiko sees Fuji. Also the Fuji view on the ¥1,000 note.
tips: Hold a ¥1,000 note up to the view.
Roads can be icy in the morning: drive slowly.

places.en: Uchiura bay: Yasudaya Ryokan and Mito Sea Paradise (Love Live! Sunshine!!)
places.ja: 内浦 安田屋旅館・伊豆・三津シーパラダイス
places.blurb: Love Live! Sunshine!!: Yasudaya is the model for Chika's family inn, the aquarium next door is home of Uchicchi, and Awashima sits in the bay with Fuji behind.

info.label: Aquarium
info.value: Izu-Mito Sea Paradise, 伊豆・三津シーパラダイス

tips: Yasudaya is a working inn: photos from outside.
The Awashima boat is not in this plan (no time).

places.en: Mishima Station (Toyota Rent a Car Mishima Shinkansen-guchi)
places.ja: 三島駅（トヨタレンタカー 三島新幹線口店）
places.blurb: Drop the car at the Toyota shop 2 min from the north (Shinkansen) exit, then take the Hikari to Kyoto.

info.label: Train
info.value: Hikari stops here about once an hour

tips: Fill the tank before you return the car.
Buy an ekiben (station lunch box) for the train.

places.ja: 都シティ 近鉄京都駅
places.blurb: Hotel built over the Kintetsu platforms at Kyoto Station: 1 min to the Nara trains, the Shinkansen and the JR Nara line to Uji. Nights 5–7 (Jan 23–25).

info.label: Price
info.value: About ¥14,000–22,000 per twin per night (estimate, not checked)

tips: On Sat Jan 23 leave your bags at the front desk at 14:40 and go straight to Nara.

places.ja: 東大寺・奈良公園
places.blurb: The giant wooden hall with the 15 m bronze Buddha, and the wild deer of Nara Park that bow for crackers.
tips: Hide maps and snacks: the deer eat paper.
Sat Jan 23 is very crowded for the fire festival.

places.en: Wakakusa Yamayaki (hill burning), seen from Tobihino
places.ja: 若草山焼き（飛火野から）
places.blurb: Once a year Nara sets the whole grass hill on fire after about 600 fireworks. Sat Jan 23, 2027.
tips: Get a place in the open Tobihino field by 17:45.
Cancelled in bad weather, with no second date.
Last trains are full: walk back to Kintetsu Nara by 19:15.

places.ja: 名古屋駅
places.blurb: Change between the Shinkansen and Kintetsu here. Good place for a Nagoya dinner: miso-katsu or tebasaki wings.
tips: Nagoya food is in ESCA underground mall (Shinkansen side).

places.en: Suzuka Circuit (EV kart on the F1 East Course)
places.ja: 鈴鹿サーキット サーキットチャレンジャー
places.blurb: Home of the Japanese F1 GP. You drive an EV kart on the real East Course (no licence needed), then walk the grandstand and pit side.

info.label: Open
info.value: Only Jan 22–25 in your trip; about 10:00–16:30

info.label: Access
info.value: Kintetsu Shiroko Station + Mie Kotsu bus, 20 min, ¥410

tips: Circuit Challenger tickets are online only (Asoview), not at the gate.
Both of you wanted this; it is the only car-track day in the plan besides the Rusutsu snow course.

places.ja: 伏見稲荷大社
places.blurb: Thousands of orange torii gates up the hill. At 07:00 the tunnel is almost empty.

info.label: Station
info.value: JR Inari (5 min from Kyoto) or Keihan Fushimi-Inari

tips: Aoki only (Pegasis marked it 'not interested' and sleeps in).
From here take the Keihan line to Uji: it is on the same line.

places.en: Uji Bridge and the Euphonium spots
places.ja: 宇治橋（響け！ユーフォニアム）
places.blurb: Hibike! Euphonium's home town: Kumiko runs across Uji Bridge (S1 ep 12). Asagiri Bridge, Agata Shrine and Keihan Uji Station are all within 10 min on foot.

info.label: Tea
info.value: Tsuen (通圓) at the bridge end

tips: The KyoAni memorial stone is in the Tea and Uji history park (free): the city asks for no flowers or offerings.
Daikichiyama lookout (S1 ep 8) is a 20-min climb and can be icy: optional.

places.en: Sanjo Meitengai arcade (Sabbat of the Witch)
places.ja: 三条名店街
places.blurb: Sabbat of the Witch: the covered shopping street of the giant-ramen scene. Eat ramen lunch here.
tips: Save the game CGs on your phone before you go and match the angles.

places.ja: 京都コンサートホール
places.blurb: The stylish building used as the school in Sabbat of the Witch, next to the Kyoto Botanical Garden.

info.label: Inside
info.value: Concert ticket holders only: outside photos

tips: The Botanical Garden next door is ¥200 if you want a warm glasshouse break.

places.ja: 金閣寺
places.blurb: The gold pavilion over its pond. If snow fell in the night, the roof is white (1–3 mornings a winter).
tips: Aoki's want. Pegasis can wait at the café by the exit or come along (45 min).

places.ja: 京都駅（大階段・中央コンコース）
places.blurb: The big glass hall and the 171-step Grand Stairway: the crowded meeting place in Sabbat of the Witch. Kyoto Ramen Koji is on 10F.

info.label: Stair lights
info.value: LED shows on the Grand Stairway after dark

tips: Your hotel is on the south side: 3 min walk.

places.ja: ホテル阪急レスパイア大阪
places.blurb: Modern hotel in the Yodobashi Umeda tower, next to Grand Front Osaka and the Itami airport bus. Night 8 (Jan 26).
tips: The airport limousine bus to Itami leaves from the Osaka Station area, 5 min walk.

places.ja: スターバックスコーヒー 神戸北野異人館店
places.blurb: A 1907 Western house used as the café 'Schwarze Katze' in Sabbat of the Witch. Drink coffee inside.
tips: The inside was renovated, so it is not the same as the game CG; the outside is.
Kobe beef lunch near Sannomiya is optional (¥3,000–6,000).

places.ja: 日本橋でんでんタウン・オタロード
places.blurb: Osaka's Akihabara: Animate, Melonbooks, Surugaya and Super Potato (retro games) on Otaroad and Sakaisuji.
tips: Shops are less crowded than Akihabara: good for last goods before Hokkaido.

places.ja: めいどりーみん 大阪日本橋オタロード店
places.blurb: Osaka's maid café with stage shows, on Otaroad. A tea break between shops.
tips: CCOちゃ (Osaka's first maid café, from 15:00) is 300 m away if you want a different style.

places.ja: 道頓堀・戎橋
places.blurb: Takoyaki, okonomiyaki and kushikatsu under the Glico running-man sign, then Hozenji Yokocho alley.

info.label: Cost
info.value: About ¥4,000–6,000 per person for many small plates

tips: Kuromon Market closes early (before 16:00): not in this plan.
Pick small bars that show prices outside.

places.ja: グランフロント大阪
places.blurb: The Umeda mall of the date scenes in Sabbat of the Witch. In the morning the plaza and atrium are quiet for photos.
tips: The public plaza and walkways are open before the shops.

places.ja: 大阪国際空港（伊丹）
places.blurb: The city airport: 25–30 min by limousine bus from Osaka Station. JAL and ANA fly to New Chitose with a 20 kg bag free.
tips: Check the ski-bag rules if you bring skis.

places.ja: 新千歳空港
places.blurb: Sapporo's airport. Arrive here on Jan 27 and leave from here on Feb 2. The domestic terminal has a ramen alley and Snow Miku Sky Town.

info.label: Snow Miku Sky Town
info.value: 雪ミク スカイタウン, domestic terminal 3F

tips: Snowstorms can delay flights: evening departures give a buffer.

places.en: Toyota Rent a Car New Chitose Airport Poplar
places.ja: トヨタレンタカー 新千歳空港ポプラ店
places.blurb: Check in at the rental counter in the arrivals hall, then a free 9-min shuttle to the shop. Studless tyres are standard in Hokkaido.

info.label: Rent
info.value: Wed Jan 27 14:15 → Sat Jan 30 13:00, return at Sapporo-ekimae

tips: Add the Hokkaido Expressway Pass only if you use the expressway a lot (you do not, in this plan).

places.ja: ニセコアンヌプリ温泉 湯心亭
places.blurb: A small onsen ryokan below the Annupuri slopes, renovated in 2024, with Hokkaido slow-food dinners. Nights 9–11 (Jan 27–29): the plan's ryokan nights.

info.label: Price
info.value: About ¥18,000–25,000 per person per night with 2 meals (estimate, Jan price not checked)

info.label: To Annupuri ski area
info.value: About 10 min; free ski shuttle if you have no car

tips: The point is the tatami room and dinner; the bath is there if you want it, not a plan item.
Cancellation fees start 30 days before; the early plan is non-refundable.

places.ja: ルスツリゾート 雪上ドリフト
places.blurb: A closed snow course with Subaru, GT-R and GR Yaris cars. Ride with a pro rally driver or drive yourself with an instructor beside you.
tips: Pegasis: email first to confirm a 1-year licence + IDP is accepted.
From Yukoro-tei about 45 min by car.

places.ja: ニセコアンヌプリ国際スキー場
places.blurb: The gentle side of Niseko: wide green runs and a ski school for Aoki's first day. Pegasis can ride the lifts over to Hirafu on the all-mountain pass.

info.label: Beginner
info.value: Half-day or single-resort ticket is cheaper

tips: In Strawberry Fields never drift left (steep chutes).
Last lifts about 16:30.

places.ja: スープカレー GARAKU
places.blurb: Sapporo's famous soup curry: a spicy broth with big vegetables and chicken. Choose spice level 1–40.
tips: Write your name on the list at the door and wait nearby.

places.ja: トヨタレンタカー 札幌駅前店
places.blurb: Return the Hokkaido car here, 6 min from JR Sapporo Station (east side, across Sosei-gawa-dori). Pin is the station.
tips: One-way fee from New Chitose: check when you book.

places.ja: ホテルルートイン札幌中央
places.blurb: Business hotel in central Sapporo with a free breakfast buffet, near Tanukikoji and Susukino. Nights 12–14 (Jan 30 – Feb 1).

info.label: Price
info.value: Twin with breakfast about ¥16,500 (Jan 31, Rakuten); Jan 30 and Feb 1 not checked

tips: Early-booking plan (早期得割) needs booking 28 days ahead.

places.ja: もいわ山
places.blurb: Ropeway and mini cable car to a 531 m summit over the lights of Sapporo. Go up before sunset (16:40) and stay for the night view.
tips: From the hotel: streetcar to Ropeway-iriguchi + free shuttle bus, about 25 min.

places.ja: 成吉思汗だるま 本店
places.blurb: Grilled lamb on a dome-shaped iron pan at a small counter, a Sapporo classic since 1954.
tips: Queue is shortest right at 17:00 or after 21:00.
Your coat will smell of lamb: use the plastic bags they give.

places.ja: 札幌駅
places.blurb: Main station for the Asahikawa limited express and the airport train.
tips: Reserve Lilac/Kamui seats on the JR Hokkaido site or at the ticket machine.

places.ja: 旭川駅
places.blurb: Change to the Asahiyama Zoo bus here (bus stop 6, about 40 min).
tips: Buy the bus + zoo set ticket at the station if it is on sale.

places.ja: 旭山動物園
places.blurb: King penguins walk in a line through the snow among the visitors. Also polar bears and snow leopards.
tips: Stand along the rope by 10:40 for the 11:00 walk.

places.ja: 蜂屋 5条創業店
places.blurb: Old Asahikawa ramen shop: pork-and-fish soup with a smoky lard top, 10 min walk from the station.
tips: Check the closing day before you go.

places.ja: 狸小路・まんだらけ札幌店
places.blurb: Sapporo's covered shopping street with Mandarake and other anime goods shops, dry in the snow.
tips: Animate Sapporo is 5 min away in the Pivot/ Sapporo centre area (check the current address).

places.ja: めいどりーみん 札幌狸小路店
